ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to 30% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density white mottling and circular patches clustered primarily along the bottom edges of both lobes, transitioning to a dominant dark-grey/black central region with scattered high-contrast white focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/5th the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edges exhibit low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities. High-amplitude, irregular protrusions (barnacle clusters) are localized on the upper distal tips, creating jagged pixel-peaks against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature extending from the central notch toward the outer tips, following a symetrical parabolic arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense distribution of circular white ring-like patterns (5-15 pixels in diameter) concentrated in the dark central zone and the upper quadrants of both lobes, indicative of past barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of live barnacles (high-intensity, textured pixel clusters) attached to the leading edges and distal tips of both lobes; heavy white circular scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral tips are heavily encrusted with barnacles, creating a unique asymmetric profile on the left tip compared to the right.
